metadata.name: Hawaii Public Assistance Programs
metadata.purpose: Help Hawaii residents discover public assistance programs and understand their general eligibility requirements.
metadata.disclaimer: Eligibility summaries are informational. The administering agency determines final eligibility. Income limits, funding, application periods, and program rules may change.
metadata.verification_policy: Do not treat missing eligibility details as evidence that an applicant qualifies. Verify current requirements with the administering agency.

programs.name: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program
programs.description: Provides monthly food purchasing assistance to eligible households.

eligibility.income_test: Household income is evaluated using applicable gross and net income standards, household size, and deductions.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable citizenship or immigration requirements.
Must provide required household and financial information.
Work requirements may apply to certain adults.
eligibility.age_requirement: No general minimum age for household participation.

income_limits.notes: These are published screening standards, not a complete eligibility determination. Applicable income tests and deductions depend on the household's circumstances.

programs.verification: Official source provides current income tables.

programs.name: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families
programs.description: Provides temporary financial assistance to eligible families with dependent children.

eligibility.household: Must meet program rules for a family with a dependent child.
eligibility.income_test: Household income is evaluated under current DHS financial standards.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable citizenship and residency requirements.
Parents or caretakers may need to participate in employment-related activities.
Child support cooperation may be required, subject to applicable exceptions.
Must provide required documentation.

programs.verification: Current numerical income thresholds require confirmation with DHS. Do not use historical poverty figures as current limits.

programs.name: Temporary Assistance for Other Needy Families
programs.description: Provides state-funded financial assistance to certain needy families who do not qualify for federal TANF because of citizenship status.

eligibility.income_test: Household financial circumstances are evaluated under applicable DHS rules.
other_requirements: Designed for certain families ineligible for federal TANF because of citizenship status.
Must meet applicable family, income, and residency requirements.
Employment-related participation requirements may apply.

programs.verification: Confirm current eligibility and citizenship rules with DHS.

programs.name: General Assistance
programs.description: Provides temporary financial assistance for basic needs to qualifying adults who are temporarily unable to work.

eligibility.income_test: Must have little or no income and meet DHS financial requirements.
other_requirements: Must have a temporary disability.
Must be certified by a DHS medical board as unable to engage in substantial employment of at least 30 hours per week for at least 60 days.
Must not qualify for a federal category of assistance.

programs.verification: Age, medical, and asset requirements published by DHS. Confirm current financial standards.

programs.name: Aid to the Aged, Blind, and Disabled
programs.description: Provides financial assistance to qualifying elderly, blind, or disabled individuals who have limited resources.

eligibility.population: Older adults and individuals who meet applicable blindness or disability definitions
eligibility.income_test: Must have countable income below the applicable DHS threshold.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable Social Security Administration disability or blindness definitions when applying under those categories.
Must meet residency and resource requirements.
Households with dependent children may be referred to TANF or TAONF.

programs.verification: DHS currently displays an income threshold based on the 2006 Federal Poverty Level. This historical figure is deliberately not presented as a current dollar limit.

programs.name: Child Care Connection Hawaii
programs.description: Helps eligible families pay for child care while parents or caretakers work, attend school, or participate in job training.

eligibility.population: Families needing assistance with child care
eligibility.child_age: Generally children under 13; exceptions may apply for older children with special needs.
eligibility.income_test: Generally based on gross household income and a percentage of state median income.
other_requirements: Parents or caretakers generally must participate in an approved activity such as employment, education, or job training.
Additional activity requirements may apply to two-parent households.
Must use an eligible child care provider.
Must submit required financial and household documents.

programs.verification: Confirm current income tables, child age rules, and caretaker activity requirements with DHS.

programs.name: Preschool Open Doors
programs.description: Helps eligible families pay for preschool tuition for young children.

eligibility.income_test: Based on gross household income and applicable state median income standards.
other_requirements: Child must meet the applicable age requirements for the program year.
Must meet household and residency requirements.
Must use an eligible preschool provider.
Applications are subject to program funding and priority rules.

programs.verification: Application periods, age rules, and income thresholds vary by program year.

programs.name: Hawaii Medicaid and Med-QUEST
programs.agency: Hawaii Department of Human Services, Med-QUEST Division
programs.description: Provides Medicaid health coverage to eligible Hawaii residents, including qualifying children, adults, pregnant individuals, older adults, and people with disabilities.

eligibility.population: Low-income residents and other eligible Medicaid categories
eligibility.income_test: Varies by eligibility group and household circumstances.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable citizenship or immigration requirements.
Must meet residency requirements.
Some eligibility categories consider age, pregnancy, disability, or need for long-term care.

programs.verification: Use the current Med-QUEST eligibility rules for the applicant's category.

programs.name: Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children
programs.description: Provides nutritious foods, nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and health referrals.
programs.benefit_type: Supplemental food benefits and nutrition services

eligibility.income_test: Must meet federal WIC income guidelines. Participation in certain assistance programs may establish income eligibility.
other_requirements: Must be a Hawaii resident.
Must have an applicable nutritional or medical risk determination.
Must complete an appointment with a local WIC agency.

programs.verification: Official source confirms population, residency, income, and nutritional risk requirements. Current income tables should be retrieved separately.

programs.name: Hawaii Home Energy Assistance Program
programs.description: Provides one-time assistance toward eligible household electric or gas bills.

eligibility.income_test: Must meet applicable household income requirements.
other_requirements: Must apply through the Community Action Agency serving the applicant's island.
Energy Crisis Intervention requires a utility disconnection notice or qualifying imminent disconnection.
Energy Credit applications are accepted during the designated annual application period.
Only one type of H-HEAP payment may be received per program year.

program_components.name: Energy Crisis Intervention
program_components.description: Assistance for eligible households facing utility disconnection.
program_components.application_period: Year-round, subject to monthly funding availability.

program_components.name: Energy Credit
program_components.description: Assistance for eligible households that need help paying energy bills.
program_components.application_period: June 1 through June 30, according to the published program schedule.

programs.verification: Confirm current income requirements, application dates, and funding with the island's Community Action Agency.

programs.name: Weatherization Assistance Program
programs.agency: Hawaii Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Office of Community Services
programs.description: Helps eligible households reduce energy costs through home energy-efficiency improvements.

eligibility.income_test: Published program standard is generally within 200 percent of the Federal Poverty Guidelines.
other_requirements: Priority may be given to older adults, people with disabilities, families with children, and households with high energy burdens.
Must meet applicable property and program requirements.
Must apply through the Community Action Agency serving the county.

programs.verification: The published 200 percent poverty guideline standard should be checked against the current program year.

programs.name: Public Housing Program
programs.description: Provides affordable rental housing to eligible low-income households.

eligibility.income_test: Household income must meet applicable HUD income limits for the area and household size.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable immigration or eligible status requirements.
Must provide household and income documentation.
Background and rental history screening may apply.
Must follow applicable public housing occupancy requirements.

programs.verification: Income limits and waiting list status vary by location and property.

programs.name: Housing Choice Voucher Program
programs.agency: Hawaii Public Housing Authority and participating housing authorities
programs.description: Helps eligible low-income households rent housing in the private market by subsidizing part of the rent.

eligibility.income_test: Generally based on HUD income limits, household size, and local area.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable HUD citizenship or eligible immigration requirements.
Must satisfy housing authority screening requirements.
Must locate a qualifying rental unit.
Must comply with program rent and occupancy rules.

programs.verification: Waiting lists may be closed or open only during designated periods. Confirm with the administering housing authority.

programs.name: Hawaii Homeless Programs
programs.agency: Hawaii Department of Human Services, Homeless Programs Office
programs.description: Coordinates services and assistance for people experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness.

eligibility.population: Individuals and families experiencing homelessness or housing instability
eligibility.income_test: Depends on the specific service or provider.
other_requirements: Some services require a documented housing crisis.
Some services use coordinated entry or assessment.
Availability depends on local providers and funding.

programs.verification: This is a service directory entry, not one universal benefit. Identify the specific local program before assessing eligibility.

programs.name: Emergency Homeless Shelter Services
programs.agency: Hawaii Department of Human Services and contracted service providers
programs.description: Connects people experiencing homelessness with emergency shelter and related support services.

eligibility.population: Individuals and families needing emergency shelter
eligibility.income_test: Varies by provider and shelter.
other_requirements: Must meet the shelter's intake and placement requirements.
Some facilities serve specific populations.
Space and availability may be limited.

programs.verification: Contact a local provider or Hawaii 211 for current shelter access information.

programs.name: Vocational Rehabilitation Services
programs.agency: Hawaii Department of Human Services, Division of Vocational Rehabilitation
programs.description: Helps eligible people with disabilities prepare for, obtain, maintain, or regain employment.

eligibility.population: People with disabilities who need vocational rehabilitation services
eligibility.income_test: Not generally based on a low-income threshold for basic eligibility; financial participation may apply to some services.
other_requirements: A physical or mental impairment must create an employment-related barrier.
The applicant must need vocational rehabilitation services to prepare for, secure, retain, or regain employment.
Must participate in the eligibility assessment and employment planning process.

programs.verification: Confirm current intake and eligibility procedures with the Division of Vocational Rehabilitation.

programs.name: Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act Adult Program
programs.agency: Hawaii Workforce Development Division and American Job Centers
programs.description: Provides employment and training services to eligible adults seeking employment or career advancement.
programs.benefit_type: Career services, training, and employment support

eligibility.income_test: Some individualized training services prioritize low-income individuals and people facing employment barriers.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable program enrollment requirements.
Must complete an assessment or career planning process when required.
Training support depends on eligibility and available funding.

programs.verification: Confirm local enrollment rules and current training funding with an American Job Center.

programs.name: Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act Youth Program
programs.agency: Hawaii Workforce Development Division and local workforce development boards
programs.description: Provides education, career exploration, work experience, and employment support to eligible young people.
programs.benefit_type: Youth employment and career development services

eligibility.age_range: Generally ages 14 through 24, depending on in-school or out-of-school status.
eligibility.income_test: Some eligibility pathways require low-income status; other statutory eligibility categories may apply.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable education or employment status requirements.
Must meet at least one eligible youth barrier or program criterion.
Must complete intake and eligibility screening.

programs.verification: Confirm local youth eligibility pathways and available services.

programs.name: SNAP Employment and Training
programs.description: Connects eligible SNAP participants with employment, education, and training services.

eligibility.income_test: Must meet SNAP participation requirements.
other_requirements: Must be eligible for or participating in SNAP.
Must meet applicable program participation requirements.
Available activities and support depend on local providers.

programs.verification: Confirm current referrals, participation rules, and provider availability with DHS.

programs.name: First-To-Work
programs.description: Provides employment preparation and work-related services to eligible financial assistance participants.

eligibility.income_test: Eligibility is connected to qualifying financial assistance participation.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable TANF or TAONF participation rules.
May require employment planning, training, job search, or work activities.
Specific exemptions and participation requirements depend on the household.

programs.verification: Confirm current participation rules with DHS.

programs.name: Hawaii Unemployment Insurance
programs.agency: Hawaii Department of Labor and Industrial Relations
programs.description: Provides temporary wage replacement to eligible workers who become unemployed through no fault of their own.

eligibility.population: Workers who have become unemployed or had qualifying reductions in work
eligibility.income_test: Must have sufficient qualifying wages during the applicable base period.
other_requirements: Must be unemployed through no fault of their own under applicable law.
Must be able and available to work.
Must meet job search and weekly certification requirements unless exempt.
Must report earnings and other required information.

programs.verification: Benefit amount and wage requirements depend on the applicable base period and current state rules.

programs.name: Refugee Cash Assistance
programs.description: Provides temporary cash assistance to certain eligible refugees and other qualifying humanitarian populations who are not eligible for TANF.

eligibility.population: Eligible refugees and certain other qualifying humanitarian immigrants
eligibility.income_test: Must meet applicable income and resource requirements.
other_requirements: Must meet federal immigration category requirements.
Must meet applicable time-limit and residency rules.
Must not be eligible for TANF.
Employment services participation may be required.

programs.verification: Confirm covered immigration categories, benefit duration, and current program availability with DHS.

programs.name: Refugee Medical Assistance
programs.description: Provides temporary medical coverage to certain eligible refugees and other qualifying humanitarian populations who do not qualify for Medicaid.

eligibility.population: Eligible refugees and other federally recognized humanitarian populations
eligibility.income_test: Must meet applicable income requirements.
other_requirements: Must meet federal immigration category requirements.
Must meet applicable arrival-date and time-limit rules.
Must not be eligible for Medicaid or other specified coverage.

programs.verification: Confirm current federal eligibility categories and Hawaii implementation with the administering agency.

programs.name: National School Lunch and School Breakfast Programs
programs.description: Provides free or reduced-price school meals to eligible students at participating schools.

eligibility.income_test: Household income is compared with federal free and reduced-price meal guidelines.
other_requirements: Some students qualify through direct certification based on participation in specified assistance programs.
School participation and local meal policies apply.

programs.verification: Check current school-year income guidelines and school meal eligibility procedures.

programs.name: Head Start and Early Head Start
programs.agency: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and local grantees
programs.description: Provides early learning, development, health, nutrition, and family support services for eligible young children.
programs.benefit_type: Early childhood education and family services

eligibility.population: Pregnant individuals, infants, toddlers, and preschool-age children depending on the program.
eligibility.income_test: Generally prioritizes families with income at or below federal poverty guidelines.
other_requirements: Children in foster care, families experiencing homelessness, and families receiving certain public assistance may qualify under specific rules.
Local program availability and enrollment priorities apply.

programs.verification: Contact a local Hawaii Head Start grantee for current enrollment and priority rules.

programs.name: Supplemental Security Income
programs.description: Provides monthly payments to eligible people with limited income and resources who are aged, blind, or disabled.

eligibility.population: People who are aged, blind, or disabled and have limited income and resources
eligibility.age_requirement: Generally age 65 or older for the aged category; younger applicants may qualify through disability or blindness.
eligibility.income_test: Countable income must fall within applicable SSI rules.
eligibility.resource_test: Countable resources must fall within applicable SSI limits.
other_requirements: Must meet applicable citizenship or eligible noncitizen requirements.
Must meet federal residence and living arrangement rules.
Disability applicants must meet the Social Security Administration definition.

programs.verification: Federal income, resource, and benefit rules can change. Check current SSA standards.

programs.name: Social Security Disability Insurance
programs.description: Provides disability benefits to eligible workers who have sufficient Social Security work credits and meet the federal disability definition.

eligibility.population: Workers with qualifying disabilities and sufficient work history
eligibility.income_test: Eligibility is not based on the same low-income test as SSI. Work activity and substantial gainful activity rules apply.
other_requirements: Must have sufficient Social Security work credits, subject to age-related rules.
Must meet the Social Security Administration's disability definition.
The disability must meet the required duration criteria.
Certain family members may qualify for related benefits.

programs.verification: Confirm current work credit, disability, and work activity rules with SSA.
